caption: The drawing depicts a single wall-mounted candle holder set against a plain, off-white background. The candle holder consists of a circular, fluted backplate with radial ridges and several star-like patterns across its surface, and there is a small round hole near the top center of the backplate. In front of the backplate, attached via a simple, curved bracket, is a shallow dish with a ribbed edge. In the center of the shallow dish is a short cylindrical holder for a candle. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black, using stippling and shading techniques to give a metallic appearance to the objects. There are no objects aside from the candle holder and its backplate in the image. In the bottom left corner, some small printed text is visible. The overall composition centers the candle holder, with its curved arm and fluted elements clearly visible.
title: Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
